text: The silent contract that decides how every mesh is styled and merged. Builders set mesh userData tags: matKind picks the cel ramp, outlineW the ink weight, part makes it a character part at 0.8x ink (CHAR_OUTLINE), noOutline skips the hull. Two tags live on the MATERIAL's userData instead: nature (with baseCol) marks environment materials that get the nature brightness gain, which toonify copies onto the new toon material and the static merge folds into its material key. Static-piece placement sets noMerge on a collider body to keep it out of the static merge. The pipeline sets its own: isOutline on every hull, _toon once a mesh is converted. A missing or misspelt tag fails silently: the mesh just gets the default ramp, the world ink weight, a hull it should not have, or the wrong brightness.

Set on meshes by builders: matKind shamble-core.js:687 (buildEntity, from the recipe's mat role) and :754 (_gunParts); outlineW :686, :716 (makeAMKRifle), :755; part :686, :716, :753, shamble-game.js:1200 ('jug'); noOutline :276 (applyVillain visor), :689 (copied from a recipe part's noOutline, e.g. :482), :716, :755, shamble-game.js:3237 (FXPool 'casing'); noMerge shamble-game.js:577, :583, :598. Set on materials: nature + baseCol :230 (sea MeshBasicMaterial), :1414 (hedge leaf), :1417 (bank), shamble-game.js:3070 (tree leaf and bark); toonify copies both to the toon material at :284. Set by the pipeline: isOutline :395 (addHull); _toon :384 (merged mesh), :415 (stylizeOne).
